context.title: League of Women Voters of San Francisco — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements

of.name: League of Women Voters of San Francisco

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition A (Charter Changes Affecting Various City Departments and Commissions)

positions.statement: The League of Women Voters of San Francisco strongly opposes Proposition A because it strips too much power from the people and hands it to City Hall, and that’s not good government.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: A public bank keeps municipal dollars working for the public good rather than funneling fees and interest to big for-profit banks.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition C (Contributions to the Housing Fund)

positions.statement: Proposition C is exactly the kind of government funding for affordable housing the League of Women Voters supports because we believe a decent place to live should be possible for San Franciscans at all income levels.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Changes to Ballot Measure Process)

positions.statement: Proposition D locks regular people out of elections and gives power to whoever can buy their way onto the ballot. The League of Women Voters of San Francisco strongly opposes this threat to democracy.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition E (City Administrator's Authority and Changes to City Contracting)

positions.statement: Proposition E hands a lot more power to an unelected official, with little accountability to match.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition F (Changes to Executive Branch Management)

positions.statement: Proposition F hands the Mayor sweeping new power over our government and removes many checks and balances.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition G (Allowing Private Vehicles on the Great Highway in Sunset Dunes Park)

positions.statement: After discussion, our board of directors decided to be neutral on Proposition G.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition H (Parcel Tax to Fund Public Muni Operations)

positions.statement: The League of Women Voters of San Francisco endorsed Proposition H early on because reliable public transit is vital for our community.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: We support Proposition I because it takes money our government already collects on big real estate deals, and uses it to help solve the affordable housing crisis, at no extra cost to most San Franciscans.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition J (Removal of Foreclosure Exemption for Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: Proposition J is the kind of progressive, equitable, and necessary taxation the League of Women Voters supports.
